newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Queen Sophia of Spain arrives in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Queen Sophia of Spain arrives in Bangladesh.

text.p: Queen Sophia of Spain arrived in Bangladesh on Friday for a six-day visit, during which she will see rural projects set up with support from the country's Grameen Bank, the official BSS news agency said.

It said Queen Sophia was invited to visit Bangladesh by Mohammad Yunus, chief of Grameen Bank, an institution which has revolutionised the nation's rural economy by offering small loans, especially to women, to set up income-generating projects.
"Grameen Bank is known to the whole world. I met Professor Yunus in Belgium and since then developed an interest in his bank," BSS quoted Queen Sophia as saying.
She will visit the bank's rural projects, and meet President Shahabuddin Ahmed and Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, it said without giving details.
